description:
LDNIO 36W fast car charger with USB‑C and USB‑A is built for drivers who want quick charging on the road—without fighting over a single port. With up to 36W total output and Quick Charge 3.0 support, it powers compatible smartphones, tablets, dash cams, and accessories faster during commutes and long drives. Plug it into any 12–24V car socket and charge two devices at once, so your phone stays ready for maps while a passenger tops up their battery.

The LED voltage display gives real-time vehicle voltage, helping you spot weak battery or alternator issues early. A compact body sits flush in most sockets, and the fire‑resistant PC housing adds heat protection for daily use. Keep it in the car and you’ll stop arriving with a dead phone—especially when you need navigation, calls, or emergency power the most.

features: Up to 36W total fast charging: Delivers strong on-road charging so your battery climbs faster during short city rides and long highway trips.
USB‑C + USB‑A dual ports: Charge two devices together—perfect for navigation phone + passenger phone, or phone + tablet.
Quick Charge 3.0 support: Enables faster charging for compatible Android devices and QC-supported gadgets (speed depends on device and cable).
LED voltage display: Shows real-time car voltage to help you monitor battery/alternator health while driving.
Fire‑resistant PC housing: Heat-resistant outer shell designed for safer daily use in hot car cabins.
Compact, flush-fit design: Sits neatly in most 12V/24V sockets without getting in the way of gear levers or storage areas.
Wide vehicle compatibility (12–24V): Works in most cars, SUVs, and trucks with standard cigarette-lighter sockets.
